title: Ruinstead
seo: Explore eight lands, gather resources, fight bosses and rebuild a ruined settlement in this 3D adventure RPG.
short: Explore, fight bosses and rebuild a village across eight lands.
about:
Ruinstead is an adventure RPG about expeditions, loot and rebuilding a ruined settlement.

Explore eight lands, from Overgrown Forest to Dragon Caldera. Cross bridges and mountain passes to find resources, chests, elite enemies and bosses.

Gather wood, stone, metal, crystals and fiber. Restore the forge and village buildings, upgrade your hero and weapons, and choose new skins. Extra equipped weapons orbit your hero and attack alongside the weapon in your hands.

Attacks happen automatically. Choose your route, dodge dangerous strikes and use potions in time. Enemies keep chasing you while you gather resources.

Return to the safe zone to recover health and deposit your loot in the expedition cache. If you are defeated, the resources and coins earned on your expedition remain at the place of death.
instructions:
On desktop:
WASD or arrow keys — move.
Space or Shift — dash.
E — interact with the nearest available chest, forge or other object.
Q or the potion button — restore health.
Tab or the minimap — world map.
P — Hero; B — Bestiary; C — Village; M — Shop.
I — Backpack; J — Quests; Escape — close a menu.

On mobile: use the virtual joystick to move and the screen buttons to dash, drink a potion, interact and open menus. Play in landscape orientation.

Attacks and resource gathering happen automatically within range. Approach the expedition cache in the safe zone to deposit loot. Spend stored resources on rebuilding the village and upgrading your equipment. Watch attack warnings, health and backpack space.
